settings.title: 10+ years of front-end, UX and WordPress experience

settings.editor: My background combines front-end development, UX thinking, SEO and WordPress. That helps me build websites that look professional, work logically and stay manageable after launch.
My foundation began at Bergo, where Magento webshop work taught me structure, consistency and how interface details improve ecommerce usability.
Blueprint Sound Academy brought me closer to visual design, refining layouts and front-end interactions for a clearer, more consistent website.
Through Kamernet, I developed stronger UX thinking with research, user flows and prototypes that turned real needs into clearer decisions.
Easytheorie helped me connect UX with WordPress and SEO, making content easier to find, understand and manage across pages.
Wube broadened my WordPress experience through client projects, responsive development and practical websites built around clearer goals and business needs.
Today, I combine WordPress, WooCommerce, Elementor, ACF, UX, SEO and performance to build structured, maintainable business websites.

settings.title: From idea to a fast, maintainable WordPress website

settings.editor: Every project starts with understanding the goal, the users and the content. From there, I turn ideas into clear structure, clean WordPress development and a website that is easy to use, fast to load and simple to maintain.
I clarify what the website needs to achieve before deciding how it should be structured and built.
I organize pages, content and user journeys so visitors can find what they need without friction.
I create clean WordPress setups that are fast, manageable and not overloaded with unnecessary plugins.
I test, refine and adjust details so the final website feels stable, usable and ready to grow.
